ABOUT US — Harmony Print Studio Skip to Content Open Menu Close Menu ABOUT US PRINT SHOP REGISTER SHOP SERVICES CUSTOMER HARMONY CONTACT 0 0 ABOUT US PRINT SHOP REGISTER SHOP SERVICES CUSTOMER HARMONY CONTACT 0 0 Open Menu Close Menu ABOUT US Folder: PRINT SHOP Back REGISTER SHOP SERVICES CUSTOMER HARMONY CONTACT About our Studio Our Story Our studio is founded on the love of creating beautiful patterns. Inspired by our name harmony, we are the perfect balance of expertise technique and creative vision. Like two perfect keys that make a pleasing chord, we blend our knowledge of commercial trends with fashion forward innovation to make industry leading artwork. With over a decade of experience working with leading brands, our shared values of collaboration, balance and harmony lead our direction. Our range of patterns is incredibly diverse, from hand crafted florals to abstract sports wear patterns. We are passionate about crafting an ever growing print library, utilising our hand drawn skills, trend forecasting and imagination. Meet the Founders Founders Rose and Vanessa met at a design company 10 years ago where they collaborated to make many beautiful patterns for high end and main street clients. After a season, they reunited, richer from all their experience and cultural influences to create an amazing textile design business. Founder and Designer Rose is a highly trusted and creative textile designer, known for crafting unique and compelling designs for companies around the world. Her work spans a wide range of industries, from food packaging to home interiors, always with a strong focus on thoughtful, expressive textile design. After moving to Vancouver, Rose expanded her practice into homewares and interiors, creating everything from intricate surface patterns to large-scale murals. Her travels across North America deepened her appreciation for diverse cultures and left a lasting mark on her artistic style. After this inspiring journey, Rose returned to London to continue her design work before settling back in Melbourne—a place she’s always felt at home—after receiving her Permanent Resident Visa. Today, her textile designs continue to connect with clients and audiences around the globe. Rose Mears Founder and Designer Vanessa is a trusted and experienced textile designer. Enriched initially by working with social enterprises to develop expert brand experiences and products too. She then continued to refine her illustration and pattern design skills by studying illustration in Paris. From there she exhibited her work at galleries, market stalls, public installations and taught art classes. At the same time she worked in-house as a textile designer, across womenswear, accessories and children’s wear. Vanessa Bong It was a delight working with Harmony Print Studio and seeing our collection come to life. Jessica Smith Enriching brands through print Exclusive Print Library Intensive print library, with polished designs and seasonal trends. Beautiful print solutions for all categories that are timeless, considered and unique. Custom hand created designs, innovation, creativity, fresh unique designs. We work within a budget and time frame. View the Library Bespoke Designs Taking inspiration from the past to create future forward designs, we can work with your inspirations to develop a custom artwork specific for your audience and company needs. Utilising our hand drawn skills and trend forecasting abilities to create unique and custom designs. Exclusive Packages We offer exclusive tailored packages to give more value. Build collections and be advised on how it can be used across different products. We also offer trend reports, colourway or scaling updates and face to face consultations with our designers. Ready to work with us? Get in Touch Sign up to keep up to date on all our fresh prints and trend research! Email Address SIGN UP Thank you! About Us Services Print Shop Contact Instagram

Services 2 — Harmony Print Studio Skip to Content Open Menu Close Menu ABOUT US PRINT SHOP REGISTER SHOP SERVICES CUSTOMER HARMONY CONTACT 0 0 ABOUT US PRINT SHOP REGISTER SHOP SERVICES CUSTOMER HARMONY CONTACT 0 0 Open Menu Close Menu ABOUT US Folder: PRINT SHOP Back REGISTER SHOP SERVICES CUSTOMER HARMONY CONTACT Our Services. How we can work together Print Collection At Harmony Print Studio, we take pride in offering an exquisite array of prints that not only adorn spaces but also inspire imagination and spark joy for those who experience them. With every new print collection, we strive to push the boundaries of creativity and innovation, while maintaining our commitment to quality and craftsmanship. Register to view our intensive print library, with polished designs and seasonal trends. Beautiful print solutions for all categories that are timeless and unique. Simple Purchase from our print shop and receive a link to download the artwork as a psd and 300dpi jpg for usage straight away. Bespoke Custom hand created designs, innovation, creativity, fresh and unique. Trend Driven Print solutions for all categories, from tropical, bohemian, beautiful florals. Register now to get access. VIEW COLLECTION Custom Print Design Need that perfect print for your next collection? Work with us to see your creative vision come to life. Taking inspiration from the past to create future forward designs, we can work with your inspirations to develop a custom artwork specific for your audience and company needs. Utilising our hand drawn skills and trend forecasting abilities to create unique and custom designs. Trend and colourway expertise Exclusive artwork competitive to the market Efficient briefing, development and production Our Process Briefing Get in touch and we’ll arrange a time to do a briefing and work with you to create a custom design brief. Design We will then work on an exclusive print created exactly from your inspiration and matching your production specifications. Delivery Turn around time 1-2 weeks. All files are provided print ready, high resolution and in seamless repeat. ENQUIRE NOW WHAT WE’RE ABOUT Dream it • Build it • Create it • Dream it • Build it • Create it • Exclusive Packages Curating We can help you develop your product range and provide supporting services such as: Yardage prints | Placement prints | Embroidery and embellishment design | Illustrations | Hand-drawn design | Putting patterns into repeat | Colour separation Consulting Need to start your new season collection and not sure where to start? Book a 1:1 consultancy session with one of our designers and we can help. Support See a print in our collection that you love but you want to put it into your seasonal colours? We’re here to make any colourway or motif updates, chat to us more to find out how we can help. Our Offering LEARN MORE Ready to work with us? GET IN TOUCH Sign up to keep up to date on all our fresh prints and trend research! Email Address SIGN UP Thank you! About Us Services Print Shop Contact Instagram
